entities.summary: Jeenathan Lewis "Nate" Williams Jr. is an American professional basketball player for the Golden State Warriors of the National Basketball Association (NBA), on a two-way contract with the Santa Cruz Warriors of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the Buffalo Bulls.
